All tests pass now. The issue was that the `build/lib/src/` directory contained an old cached version of the code with a bug (missing subtractive notation values), and pytest was importing from there due to the conftest.py configuration. After removing the build directory, pytest correctly imports from `src/roman.py` which contains the fixed code.

The fix is correct - all 6 tests pass.

All tests pass now that I've removed the stale build directory. The bug was that the old cached code in `build/lib/src/` was missing the subtractive notation values (CM, CD, XC, XL, IX) and had incorrect ordering. The fixed code in `src/roman.py` is correct - all 6 tests pass.
